evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Before I start here, I just like to ask Fabio if you have any concern about the moving process. Do you have any worries that you'd like to talk about?' — asked before logistics probing. Full credit.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer reassured he'd done long-distance moves before, no real worry raised — 15/15 via the no-concern-raised exception.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'If ever the move takes less than this, you will only be charged for how much time we used' present; missing rate/experience, self-prep tip, fair-check.

top_strength: Handled a comparison-shopping objection gracefully, without pressure ('you can review and maybe compare with other companies') — good long-game instinct.
coaching_note: Add the four differentiators — the discovery open was excellent but nothing from Sheets 1-4 landed anywhere in the call.
